headline: Deadlocked reaches 2.42% with shared, multiplayer and game routines
summary: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 matched code rose from 1.33% to 2.42%, with 1,566 of 15,056 functions reported finished after #4 merged. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The batch spans shared object helpers, multiplayer menus, serializers and core game routines.
highlights: New relocation checks find functions pointing at the wrong globals and repair six of them.
Further corrections fix global reads and four switch tables.
#5 proposes native Windows tooling and #6 another decompilation batch. Neither has merged.
#7 and #8 propose 38 shared helpers checked only against PAL with masked comparisons. NTSC-U validation and progress checks are still needed.
